Raw data

Everything above can be rebuilt from these files, which update daily:

  • site-traffic-raw.csv: every Clarity value, one row per day, metric, page and field (opens in Excel)
  • clarity_history.json: the daily Clarity exports exactly as stored
  • site-traffic.json: the numbers shown on this page

A page visit is a session that viewed that page, so one session that opens three pages counts three times. Clarity only counts visitors who accept the consent bar, so real reach is higher than shown.
